message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to bid or drop out on the current auction.

The current bid is $73. I will raise to $74 and continue bidding until I reach about $150. That keeps the mortgage value and blocks p4 from completing a PA+NC pair.

If p4 pushes past the $150 cap, I will drop out and let them bleed. The mortgage value is exactly $150, so buying for that amount nets zero cash while blocking them. They cannot complete a green monopoly anyway because Pacific is owned by p1.

Blocking the PA+NC pair is only a moderate strategic move. p4 already has PA mortgaged, so they cannot build a green monopoly without Pacific anyway.

The real threat is p1's dark blue properties. p1 is nearly broke with heavy development on Park Place and Boardwalk. I am currently positioned on Pennsylvania Avenue.

I have $726 cash. Selling houses to pay rent on p1's dark blues would hurt my income. The $74 bid is well under the $150 cap. I will keep forcing p4 to spend more. They have $763 and are in jail. They want NC badly.
